page.layout: One column of running text. Printed page number top left. Running head at top, decorated and partly illegible. Handwritten ink annotations in the left margin and on the text, not printed, so not transcribed.

main_text.p: utranque rationem in libro-rum nostrorum interpretatione adhibere necesse est.

Quod ut rectè atque idoneè possimus, primùm in Latinę linguae scriptoribus antiquis adolescentiam consumpsif-se omnem oportet. deinde codicum, tum manuscriptorum, tum impressorum, copia mediocriter instructum esse. quo in genere laudis videó nostra hac ætate Budęũ[?], Ranconnetum, Alciatũ, Haloandrum, Duarenum, Connanum, Cuiacium, aliosque nonnullos antecellere. Dialectica autem ratio, si Iuris disciplinam universè spectemus, spectemus.

page.notes: Handwritten ink marks in the left margin and "Dialectica" written in the text margin are manuscript annotations and were left out. The running head is set in decorative type; the letters after "IN." are illegible. "Budęũ" is uncertain. The word "Dialectica" is split across lines without a printed hyphen. The last sentence ends in "spectemus," as printed; check the line-end reading "specte-mus," as the scan may show "spectemus," only. The reading "videó" is doubtful and should be checked against the scan.
